priority: P0 — exam-a0 hear-act (toca/señala/abre) and hear-choose prompts (da/dice/hacer) depend on these forms; gap inventory G1
why: Shipped content speaks ~25 verb forms + the three TPR commands that no pack teaches. a1-u01 already assumes hay and esta/estan as known grammar (CONTENT-a1-pack.md), so this pack closes that hole too. Includes sol + paz as real pool words, killing the phantom decoys of DEFECTS #14.
theme: Acciones y órdenes — the verbs the world already speaks, plus how things are
storyThread: Un día en el pueblo: mirar, hablar, comer, orar, y la paz de casa

words.caption: Hay pan en la mesa
words.note: one form for both singular and plural

words.say: La olla está en la mesa.
words.caption: La olla está en la mesa
words.note: from estar; hay names a thing, está says where it is

words.caption: Yo tengo un libro
words.note: from tener; yo tengo = I have

words.caption: Me gusta el pan
words.note: literally «it is pleasing to me»

words.say: Mira la casa. Mira el árbol.
words.caption: Mira la casa
words.note: command from mirar; the form children hear most

words.caption: El jet dice palabras
words.note: from decir

words.caption: En mi casa hay paz
words.note: closes DEFECTS #14: real pool word for the pan/paz pair

words.caption: Ana ora a Dios
words.note: from orar; sounds like hora (hour) — the sentence carries the meaning

words.caption: Vamos al pueblo
words.note: from ir; ¡vamos! = let's go

words.caption: Yo vivo aquí
words.note: from vivir

words.caption: ¿Quieres jugar?
words.note: from querer; e → ie in the stressed form

words.caption: Pip y yo jugamos
words.note: from jugar; nosotros jugamos

words.caption: Me gusta hacer pan
words.note: the infinitive: to make, to do

words.caption: Mamá te da pan
words.note: from dar

words.caption: Yo también
words.note: también = me too

words.caption: Muy grande
words.note: muy grande = very big

words.caption: Ahora como pan
words.note: the h is silent: ah-OH-rah

words.say: El trigo crece en el campo.
words.caption: El trigo crece
words.note: from crecer

words.caption: Hay sol en el cielo
words.note: closes DEFECTS #14: real pool word for the sal/sol pair

words.caption: Como pan y queso
words.note: from comer; como also means «like, as»

words.caption: Bebo agua fría
words.note: from beber

words.caption: Duermo en mi cama
words.note: from dormir; o → ue in the stressed form

words.caption: El camino lleva al pueblo
words.note: from llevar; also in this pack's scripture

words.caption: La mesa es grande
words.note: one form for masculine and feminine

words.caption: La uva es pequeña
words.note: pequeño / pequeña; ñ = ny as in canyon

words.caption: La casa es bonita
words.note: bonito / bonita

words.caption: Aquí está mi casa
words.note: aquí = here, allí = there

words.caption: Toca la puerta
words.note: TPR command from tocar — the exam says «Toca la casa»

words.caption: Señala el árbol
words.note: TPR command from señalar; ñ = ny

words.caption: Abre la ventana
words.note: TPR command from abrir — the exam says «Abre la ventana»

QA.charset: ASCII + á é í ó ú ñ ¿ ¡ only in rendered fields; « » appear only in English notes and scripture.say (spoken-only)
QA.grammar: present tense + affirmative imperatives (mira/toca/señala/abre/vamos) only; no past, no subjunctive, no subjunctive formulas in authored lines; scripture exempt per lead ruling
QA.duplicateCheck: zero overlap with unit-01.json (52 ids) or a0-packs.json (49 ids) — union becomes 131 unique ids
QA.optionsBoundToIds: every option string is a bound id: 30 from this pack + pan/sal (a0-u04). No phantom decoys (DEFECTS #14)
QA.formIdRule: ids are the form the learner hears and the string on screen (mirar→mira, estar→está, decir→dice, tener→tengo, gustar→me gusta, ir→vamos, vivir→vivo, querer→quieres, jugar→jugamos, dar→da, comer→como, beber→bebo, dormir→duermo, crecer→crece, llevar→lleva, orar→ora, tocar→toca, señalar→señala, abrir→abre; only hacer stays infinitive)
